elements.texte:
[cheerful] The complete query calculates the amount of each order in the subquery,

Then averages these amounts in the main query to get the average basket.

The query returns a single value: the average basket requested, about €46.72 per order.

The 16 orders total €747.50. Dividing this total by 16, we get an average basket of about €46.72.

The finance team can update its indicator for the month.
